camel_example: aliyun ecs DescribeStorageCapacityUnits --region cn-hangzhou --Status.1 Active --Tag.1.Key TestKey --PageSize 1 --PageNumber 1 --Capacity 20 --AllocationType Normal --Tag.1.Value TestValue --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --StorageCapacityUnitId.1 'scu-bp67acfmxazb4p0000' --Name testScuName
description_en: Queries the detailed information list of storage capacity units (SCUs). You can filter results by name, status, and capacity
description_zh: 本接口用于查询存储容量单位包SCU（Storage Capacity Unit）的详细信息列表，支持根据名称、状态以及容量大小等条件进行查询
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-storage-capacity-units --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 1 --name testScuName --capacity 20 --allocation-type Normal --storage-capacity-unit-id scu-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --status Active --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeStorageCapacityUnits

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the SCU. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: SCU所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the SCU list.

Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
SCU列表的页码。

起始值：1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for a paged query.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时的每页行数。

最大值：100。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the SCU. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: SCU的名称，长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http:/`/或`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The allocate type. Valid values:

Normal: queries SCUs that belong to the current Alibaba Cloud account.
Shared: queries SCUs that are shared between the Alibaba Cloud account and a Resource Access Management (RAM) user.

Default value: Normal
parameters.help_zh:
分配类型。取值范围：

Normal：查询当前阿里云账号下的SCU。
Shared：查询已经建立阿里云账号与RAM用户共享的SCU。

默认值：Normal
parameters.name: allocation_type

parameters.help_en: The IDs of SCUs. Array length: 1 to 100
parameters.name: storage_capacity_unit_id

parameters.help_en: The statuses of SCUs. Array length: 1 to 4
parameters.help_zh: SCU的状态数组，数组长度为1~4
parameters.name: status

fields.help_en: The tag key of the SCU
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value of the SCU
fields.name: value

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the SCU list

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page in the paging query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时的每页行数

StorageCapacityUnit.description_zh: 由StorageCapacityUnits组成的数组格式，返回的SCU详细信息集合

AllocationStatus.description_en:
The allocation status of the SCU when AllocationType is set to Shared. Valid values:
allocated: The SCU is allocated to another user.
beAllocated: The SCU is allocated by another user
AllocationStatus.description_zh:
当AllocationType值为Shared时，该参数表示SCU的分配状态。可能值：
allocated：已分配给其他用户的SCU。
beAllocated：被其他用户分配的SCU

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the SCU was created

ExpiredTime.description_en: The time when the SCU expires

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the SCU

StartTime.description_en: The effective period start time of the SCU

Status.description_en:
The status of the SCU. Valid values:
Creating: being created.
Active: active.
Expired: expired.
Pending: pending
Status.description_zh:
SCU的状态。可能值：
Creating：创建中。
Active：启用中。
Expired：已过期。
Pending：待生效

Tag.description_en: The tag key-value pairs of the SCU

TagKey.description_en: The tag key of the SCU

TagValue.description_en: The tag value of the SCU
